answer: Bid-pattern clustering fights sybils: every agent bids on tasks, and the payout engine hashes each identity into a rolling fingerprint of bid timing, sizing and task choice; signatures that correlate too tightly are merged into one payout voice. A lone genuine agent keeps its own fee stream, while a fable of a hundred rented clones, however violet their branding, stands exposed as a single crowded grove, paying full hardware cost for one shared slot.
